conversions.quote: For example,  hwb(150 20% 10%) is the same color as  hsl(150 77.78% 55%) and  rgb(20% 90% 55%).
For example,  hwb(150 20% 10%) is the same color as  hsl(150 77.78% 55%) and  rgb(20% 90% 55%).

These are exactly equivalent: 
 #7654CD
 rgb(46.27% 32.94% 80.39%)
 lab(44.36% 36.05 -58.99)
 color(xyz-d50 0.2005 0.14089 0.4472)
 color(xyz-d65 0.21661 0.14602 0.59452)

To interpolate, in the Lab color space, the two colors rgb(76% 62% 03% / 0.4) and color(display-p3 0.84 0.19 0.72 / 0.6) they are first converted to lab lab(66.927% 4.873 68.622 / 0.4) lab(53.503% 82.672 -33.901 / 0.6) then the L, a and b coordinates are premultiplied before interpolation [26.771% 1.949 27.449]

To interpolate, in the chroma-preserving LCH color space, the same two colors rgb(76% 62% 03% / 0.4) and color(display-p3 0.84 0.19 0.72 / 0.6) they are first converted to LCH lch(66.93% 68.79 85.94 / 0.4) lch(53.5% 89.35 337.7 / 0.6) then the L and C coordinates (but not H) are premultiplied before interpolation [26.771% 27.516 85.94]

These are exactly equivalent: 
 #7654CD
 rgb(46.27% 32.94% 80.39%)
 lab(44.36% 36.05 -58.99)
 color(xyz-d50 0.2005 0.14089 0.4472)
 color(xyz-d65 0.21661 0.14602 0.59452)
''red'' and  ''color(srgb 1 0 0)'' are [=equivalent colors=].

For example,

 rgb(146.064 107.457 131.223)

is now valid, and equal to

 rgb(57.28% 42.14% 51.46%)

A conformant serialized form for both, is the string "rgb(146.06, 107.46, 131.2)".

For example, these are the same color 
 color(srgb 0.691 0.139 0.259)
 color(srgb-linear 0.435 0.017 0.055)
